correctness.rationale: PASS. A maximum cycle-free multipath face on the complete loopless bidirected graph has n−1 arcs and is exactly one directed Hamiltonian path, giving n! distinct top oriented simplices in degree n−2. Closing each path yields its unique directed Hamiltonian cycle; different cycles partition the n! facets into (n−1)! blocks of n. The oriented missing-cycle boundary z_C is an integral top cycle with primitive ±1 coefficients. For every consecutive (n−2)-arc path plus isolated vertex, exactly two top cofaces close to the same C, forcing adjacent top coefficients to have the z_C ratio; these constraints connect each block and prove all integral top cycles are sums of z_C. No chains exist one degree above. The S_n stabilizer of each directed cycle is C_n and its rotation acts by (-1)^{n−1} on the cycle boundary; induced integral module follows. Rational transfer after barycentric subdivision and Frobenius reciprocity give S_n and A_n orbit-space top dimensions 1/0 and 2/1 by n parity. Independently reconstructed the complete n=3,4,5,6 Hamiltonian facet partitions and all two-coface incidences; finite checks are not substituted for the n-parameter proof.
